title: Built around Ethiopian coffee, infrastructure and dependable trade relationships.
intro: Hayked General Trading PLC is an Ethiopian-owned company focused on coffee processing, warehousing and export coordination.
storyTitle: A practical partner for coffee preparation and storage.
storyText: Hayked brings physical infrastructure and direct buyer communication together so coffee and service requirements can be discussed, prepared and followed through clearly.
mission: Deliver professionally prepared Ethiopian coffee and dependable trading support to global buyers.
vision: Become a trusted and innovative African company in coffee processing, warehousing, exporting and diversified trade.
facilityText: Real facility photography gives buyers and service clients a clearer view of Hayked’s operational environment. Specific capacity, equipment and service information is confirmed directly for each enquiry.
